LanguageData.LP_FeatMagicMissile.label: magic missile
LanguageData.LP_FeatMagicMissile.description: Magic Initiate (without VPE): an unerring force missile dealing 8 + adventurer level force damage, range 20. Cooldown 8 hours (about 3 per day).
LanguageData.LP_FeatDisguise.label: disguise
LanguageData.LP_FeatDisguise.description: Actor: change your look and blend into the crowd. For 2 minutes enemies will almost never prioritize targeting this person. 2 per day.
LanguageData.LP_FeatCalmMind.label: soothe mind
LanguageData.LP_FeatCalmMind.description: Telepathy: instantly calm a colonist within 30 cells who is having a mental break. 3 per day.
LanguageData.LP_FeatCoatBlade.label: coat weapon in poison
LanguageData.LP_FeatCoatBlade.description: Poisoner: brew 1 herbal medicine (carried or on the map) into poison and coat a weapon; the next 20 melee hits apply spider queen venom. Cooldown 1 hour.
LanguageData.LP_FeatRitualCast.label: ritual casting
LanguageData.LP_FeatRitualCast.description: Ritual Caster: channel standing for 1 hour (interruption wastes it); the ability with the longest remaining cooldown finishes cooling down instantly, and for 1 hour afterwards the next cast triggers no cooldown and adds no neural heat. 2 per day, only usable while an ability is on cooldown.
